title: 31 December 1965: The Beatles attend New Year's Eve parties
content:
Paul McCartney, Jane Asher, George Harrison and Pattie Boyd saw in 1966 at a New Year’s Eve party hosted by EMI executives in London.

John Lennon and his wife Cynthia, meanwhile, spent the evening at a party held by record producer and songwriter Norman Newell.

Page last updated: 20 June 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2002: Sir Paul McCartney is presented with his coat of arms
  • 1972: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend New Year party at Mercer Arts Center, New York City
  • 1970: Paul McCartney files a lawsuit to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership
  • 1966: George Harrison is refused entry to Annabel’s nightclub in London
  • 1964: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
  • 1963: Live: The Beatles’ Christmas Show
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
  • 1962: Heather McCartney is born
  • 1960: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
